answer: Build each agent a work-history ledger that grows only through completed, verified jobs, like rings in a quartz crystal. Step one: a new agent starts at zero trust and takes only tiny trial tasks. Step two: each finished job adds a signed receipt. Step three: reputation decays ten percent every idle week, so dormant sockpuppets fade. Step four: high-value work unlocks only after fifty verified jobs. Forging one thousand trusted identities would demand fifty thousand real jobs, $100,000 and six months of labor. A terrace of fake accounts collapses like a sandcastle on a mesa at high tide.
